question: Which of the following is not carried in dorsal column of spinal cord:March 2011
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Dorsal column carries sensory information" -> "Includes proprioception" -> "Includes vibratory sense" -> "Does not include heat sensation" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Dorsal column pathways" -> "Responsible for fine touch" -> "Includes proprioception and vibratory sense" -> "Heat sensation is carried by spinothalamic tract" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Dorsal column function" -> "Transmits proprioception and touch" -> "Vibratory sense is also transmitted" -> "Heat sensation is not transmitted" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Dorsal column of spinal cord" -> "Transmits specific sensory modalities" -> "Proprioception and touch are included" -> "Heat sensation is excluded" -> 80%
analysis: The dorsal column of the spinal cord primarily carries proprioception, vibratory sense, and fine touch sensations. Heat sensation is transmitted through the spinothalamic tract, not the dorsal column.
